title: INI’s ‘You Know What To Do’ Logs Group’s Seventh No. 1 on Japan Hot 100
summary: EBiDAN's "Yes! Tokyo" slips to No. 2 after holding at No. 1 for two straight weeks.
contentText:
INI ‘s “You Know What To Do” tops the Billboard Japan Hot 100 , on the chart released Sept. 23.

The title track of the group’s ninth single “ANTHEM,” released Sept. 16, launched with 823,028 copies to top the sales metric — surpassing the half-million mark for the tenth consecutive release. The track also lands at No. 2 on both radio airplay and downloads, securing the group’s seventh No. 1 on the Japan Hot 100, following “All 4 U.”

EBiDAN’s “Yes! Tokyo” slips to No. 2 after holding at No. 1 for two straight weeks, but sales climb to 197% and streaming to 103% of last week’s figures. M!LK’s “Jiku Koete Universe” remains at No. 3, topping both radio and video views this week. YAO’s “Arifureta Sekai no Hate ni” rises 11-4, hitting No. 1 on streaming with overall points growing to 133% of last week’s total. Mrs. GREEN APPLE’s “Brand New” climbs a spot to No. 5.

M!LK’s “Sukisugite Metsu!” follows at No. 6, Spitz’s “Mishiranu Ito” at No. 7, SixTONES’ “My Only” at No. 8, M!LK’s “Bakuretsu Aishiteru” at No. 9, and ILLIT’s “It’s Me” at No. 10 — with M!LK placing three songs simultaneously in the top 10, including “Jiku Koete Universe” at No. 3. “My Only” continues to gain ground with streaming up 112% week-over-week for a third consecutive week of chart gains. BE:FIRST’s “WATCH ME feat. BIA” makes its chart debut at No. 11 and Macaroni Enpitsu’s “Unmei Sagashi” at No. 13.

The Billboard Japan Hot 100 combines physical and digital sales, audio streams, radio airplay, video views and karaoke data.
